jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
The Onboarding Specialist provides administrative support throughout the employee onboarding process. This role coordinates onboarding activities, maintains HRIS and personnel records, supports compliance requirements, and responds to employee and supervisor inquiries. As part of the Human Resource Team, you’ll help ensure a smooth, accurate, and compliant onboarding experience for new employees.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Deliver an exceptional candidate experience from initial contact through onboarding.
* Coordinate background checks, fingerprinting, and required employment clearances.
* Manage onboarding for new hires, transfers, and temporary staff.
* Coordinate new hire appointments, paperwork, credential verification, and ID cards.
* Create and maintain accurate, compliant employee files.
* Conduct employee file audits to ensure required documentation is complete.
* Maintain accurate employee records and updates in ADP.
* Support employees and supervisors with basic HR policy and procedure questions.
* Build employer brand visibility through candidate\-focused events and initiatives.
* Review employee documentation to ensure compliance with agency and funder requirements.
* All other duties as assigned.

 **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree preferred
* 1\-2 years of experience as an HR Assistant plus 1 year of experience in Recruiting
* Ability to work in a high\-volume environment, including ability to balance priorities and meet important deadlines
* Strong attention to detail and follow through
* Effective communication and customer service skills
* Bilingual Spanish preferred

**Work Environment**
Corporate Office**Position Type/Expected Hours of Work**
This is a full\-time position. Monday through Friday. Work hours options are 9:00 am \- 5:00 pm, 9:30 am \- 5:30pm**Benefits \& Compensation*** Competitive salary structure
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* PTO policy (11 Paid Holidays, Paid Sick Time, Paid Vacation \& Paid Personal Days)
* Remote / flexible work options
**Additional Requirements*** Authorized to work in the U.S.
* Ability to work in\-person in New York City (NYC)
* Ability to travel to other Rising Ground Sites (if required)

jobs.title: Benefitfocus Sr Implementation Consultant
jobs.description:
***Together we fight for everyone’s opportunity for a better financial future.***


We will do this together — with customers, partners and colleagues. We will fight for others, not against: We will stand up for and champion everyone’s access to opportunities. The status quo is not good enough … we believe every individual and every community deserves access to financial opportunities. We are determined to support both individuals and communities in reaching a better financial future. We know that reaching this future depends on our actions today.


Like our Purpose Statement, Voya believes in being bold and committed to action. We are committed to a work environment where the differences that we are born with — and those we acquire throughout our lives — are understood, valued and intentionally pursued. We believe that our employees own our culture and have a responsibility to foster an environment where we all feel comfortable bringing our whole selves to work. Purposefully bringing our differences together to positively influence our culture, serve our clients and enrich our communities is essential to our vision.

**Are you ready to join a company with a strong purpose and a winning culture? Start your Voyage –****Apply Now**

**Get to Know the Opportunity:**
--------------------------------


Benefitfocus, Inc., a Voya company, is a leading provider of cloud\-based benefits software solutions for consumers, employers, insurance carriers, and brokers. Benefitfocus serves millions of consumers through an integrated portfolio of products and services that enable clients to efficiently shop, enroll, manage, and exchange benefits information. With a user\-friendly interface and consumer\-centric design, the Benefitfocus Platform provides a single destination for consumers to access and manage their benefits.


Benefitfocus is seeking an HCM Sr Implementation Consultant to join our Customer Success Organization. In this role, you will be responsible for gathering data integration requirements and delivering solutions that meet clients’ data integration needs. You will support both new employer groups during implementation and existing customers navigating business changes that impact how data is exchanged with Benefitfocus.


As an HCM Sr Implementation Consultant, you will develop expertise in Benefitfocus and industry\-standard integration approaches while partnering with customers, payroll vendors, HCM providers, and internal engineering teams to ensure timely, accurate, and high\-quality data integrations. Success in this role requires a strong customer focus, technical aptitude, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a fast\-paced environment.

***This role is remote; however, candidates must be located within commutable proximity to one of our major office locations to support periodic onsite collaboration, team connection, and business priorities.***

**The Contributions You’ll Make:**
----------------------------------

* Work with customer payroll vendors to determine outbound deduction file or API integration requirements.
* Partner with customer HCM system teams to identify inbound demographic file or API integration requirements.
* Extract files and ensure successful, accurate, and timely delivery to vendors.
* Facilitate discovery sessions, integration overviews, training sessions, and implementation project meetings.
* Gather and analyze customer integration requirements and recommend appropriate integration solutions.
* Translate customer requirements into accurate and concise requirements documentation for internal engineering review and development.
* Refine requirements documentation based on customer feedback and engineering team recommendations.
* Develop and execute testing plans to validate data integrations.
* Oversee and support component testing and user acceptance testing activities.
* Triage, troubleshoot, and resolve issues identified during testing and implementation.
* Ensure successful transitions from customer legacy file transmission processes and data to the Benefitfocus platform.
* Obtain customer and internal engineering sign\-off and coordinate smooth transitions to ongoing production support teams.
* Partner with project managers to align integration deliveries with overall implementation milestones.
* Adapt to a fast\-paced environment while effectively managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
* Successfully manage a workload of 10 to 15 concurrent implementation and integration projects.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Operations, Sales, and other cross\-functional partners to ensure shared knowledge and successful project outcomes.
* Provide training, mentorship, and support to junior associates.
* Support team initiatives and perform other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Knowledge \& Experience:**
------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree required.
* 6\+ years of experience in a SaaS implementation environment.
* Experience with systems integration and field\-level interface design.
* Experience with file transmission processes and integrations with external vendors.
* Strong business application consulting experience with direct client\-facing responsibilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and priorities.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and effectively partner with engineering teams.

**Preferred Knowledge \& Experience:**
--------------------------------------

* Knowledge of payroll systems.
* Knowledge of employee benefit plans and benefit administration structures.
* Experience working with HR technology platforms, data integrations, and benefits administration systems.

**How This Role Aligns to Our Core Four:**
------------------------------------------


At Voya, our Core Four reflect how we work together to deliver meaningful results for our customers, clients, and one another. This role supports those expectations by combining customer partnership, technical expertise, collaboration, and execution excellence.

* **Instill Customer Obsession:** Deliver accurate and scalable integration solutions that simplify benefits administration and create a positive client experience.
* **Transform with Automation/AI:** Leverage technology, automation, and data\-driven tools to streamline integrations, improve quality, and reduce manual effort across implementation projects.
* **Drive Higher Performance Through Our People:** Partner effectively with customers, vendors, project teams, engineering teams, and junior associates to build knowledge, accountability, and successful outcomes.
* **Execute on the Fundamentals:** Ensure integrations are documented, tested, implemented, and transitioned with a high degree of accuracy, consistency, and operational excellence.


\#LI\-LH1

**Compensation Pay Disclosure:**

Voya is committed to pay that’s fair and equitable, which means comparable pay for comparable roles and responsibilities.


The below annual base salary range reflects the expected hiring range(s) for this position in the location(s) listed. In addition to base salary, Voya may offer incentive opportunities (i.e., annual cash incentives, sales incentives, and/or long\-term incentives) based on the role to reward the achievement of annual performance objectives. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Voya Financial is willing to pay at the time of this posting.


Actual compensation offered may vary from the posted salary range based upon the candidate’s geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer. Salaries for part\-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.


$95,000 \- $110,000**Be Well. Stay Well.**


Voya provides the resources that can make a difference in your lives. To us, this means thriving physically, financially, socially and emotionally. Voya benefits are designed to help you do just that. That’s why we offer an array of plans, programs, tools and resources with one goal in mind: To help you and your family be well and stay well.

**What We Offer**

* Health, dental, vision and life insurance plans
* 401(k) Savings plan – with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%)
* Voya Retirement Plan – employer paid cash balance retirement plan (4%)
* Paid time off – including 20 days paid time off, nine paid company holidays and a flexible Diversity Celebration Day.
* Paid volunteer time — 40 hours per calendar year

 **Critical Skills**


At Voya, we have identified the following critical skills which are key to success in our culture:


* **Customer Focused**: Passionate drive to delight our customers and offer unique solutions that deliver on their expectations.
* **Critical Thinking**: Thoughtful process of analyzing data and problem solving data to reach a well\-reasoned solution.
* **Team Mentality**: Partnering effectively to drive our culture and execute on our common goals.
* **Business Acumen**: Appreciation and understanding of the financial services industry in order to make sound business decisions.
* **Learning Agility**: Openness to new ways of thinking and acquiring new skills to retain a competitive advantage.

 **Equal Employment Opportunity**

*Voya Financial is an equal\-opportunity employer. Voya Financial provides equal opportunity to qualified individuals regardless of race, color, sex, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, disability, veteran status, creed, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other status protected by state or local law.*

**Reasonable Accommodations**

*Voya is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Voya will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment,* *please* *reference* *resources for applicants with disabilities**.*

jobs.title: RHTP Primary Care Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Let’s do great things, together!**


**About Moda**  

Founded in Oregon in 1955, Moda is proud to be a company of real people committed to quality. Today, like then, we’re focused on building a better future for healthcare. That starts by offering outstanding coverage to our members, compassionate support to our community and comprehensive benefits to our employees. It keeps going by connecting with neighbors to create healthy spaces and places, together. Moda values diversity and inclusion in our workplace. We aim to demonstrate our commitment to diversity through all our business practices and invite applications from candidates that share our commitment to this diversity. Our diverse experiences and perspectives help us become a stronger organization. Let’s be better together.

  

**Position Summary**



The RHTP Primary Care Implementation Specialist serves as a key liaison between Moda Health and partners at rural hospital\-based primary care clinics on Alaska’s Kenai Peninsula. This role provides technical assistance, subject matter expertise, and project management oversight to advance value\-based payment (VBP) readiness through the National Committee on Quality Assurance (NCQA) Primary Care Medical Home (PCMH) implementation. The position partners with hospital and clinic stakeholders to implement a robust quality improvement and data reporting infrastructure to enable quality measure reporting, support population health management, and prepare clinics for sustainable VBP participation through the NCQA PCMH model.



This is a full\-time position. The ideal candidate will reside in Alaska’s Anchorage/Kenai Peninsula region. *This is a limited duration position contingent on continued receipt of RHTP grant funds.*

  


**Pay Range**



$65,682\.16 \- $82,107\.97annually (depending on experience)  

Actual pay is based on qualifications. Applicants who do not exceed the minimum qualifications will only be eligible for the low end of the pay range.

  

**Please fill out an application on our company page, linked below, to be considered for this position.**



https://j.brt.mv/jb.do?reqGK\=27785428\&refresh\=true  

  

**Benefits****:**


* Medical, Dental, Vision, Pharmacy, Life, \& Disability
* 401K\- Matching
* FSA
* Employee Assistance Program
* PTO and Company Paid Holidays

  

  

**Required Skills, Experience \& Education:**



* Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Public Health, Public Policy, or Healthcare Administration\-related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.


* 3 \- 5 years of experience working in healthcare, public health, or health\-related community\-based organizations. Experience working in or with rural or underserved communities preferred.


* Familiarity with NCQA PCMH and/or Oregon’s Patient\-Centered Primary Care Home requirements and recognition processes.


* Demonstrated understanding of value\-based payment (VBP) systems and APMs in healthcare settings.


* Knowledge of primary care clinic functions such as case management/care coordination, use of electronic health record (EHR) systems, population health\-level metrics and reporting, behavioral health integration, and collaboration with Traditional Health Workers (THWs).


* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially MS Excel and other reporting software.


* Strong verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.
* Experience convening diverse stakeholders and facilitating productive virtual and in\-person meetings.


* Ability to manage complex projects, track activities, and meet short and long\-term project milestones.


* Ability to maintain confidentiality and project a professional business image.
  


**Primary Functions****:**



* Serve as subject matter expert to partner hospital organization leadership on all matters related to PCMH recognition and Alternative Payment Model (APM) design and implementation.


* Regularly meet with steering committee composed of executive leadership from both Alaska hospitals, Moda Health subject matter experts, and statewide policy partners to guide PCMH implementation, resolve barriers, and ensure shared ownership of key decisions.


* Use project management skills to create and maintain detailed implementation plan and task trackers across multiple stakeholder organizations.


* Provide technical assistance to partner organizations, enabling achievement of core and elective criteria for PCMH recognition across the concepts of team\-based care and practice organization, knowing and managing patients, patient\-centered access, care management and support, care coordination and transitions, performance measurement and quality improvement, and behavioral health integration.


* Partner closely with Medicaid Quality and Innovation Manager, Grants Management Specialist, and Medicaid Quality Supervisor to support clinical partners in meeting RHTP requirements and timeline.


* Use independent judgment to make key business decisions and provide informed recommendations on PCMH criteria implementation and APM design to partner organizations and Moda Health senior leadership.


* Perform other duties as assigned.
  



Working Conditions \& Contact with Others:


* Office environment with extensive close PC and keyboard use, constant sitting, and frequent phone communication. Must be able to navigate multiple computer screens. A reliable, high\-speed, hard\-wired internet connection required to support remote or hybrid work. Must be comfortable being on camera for virtual training and meetings. Work in excess of standard workweek, including evenings and occasional weekends, to meet business need. Occasional and overnight travel may be required.
* Internally with all Moda departments. Externally with partner healthcare organizations and vendors.

  


**Together, we can be more. We can be better.**

  

Moda Health seeks to allow equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other status protected by law. This is applicable to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absences, compensation, and training.  

  

For more information regarding accommodations please direct your questions to Kristy Nehler and Danielle Baker via our humanresources@modahealth.com email.

jobs.title: Deployment & Training Specialist - East Coast Required
jobs.description:
**Deployment \& Training Specialist**
=====================================

**Department:** Training / Deployments  

**Location:** Remote \| East Coast preferred  

**Salary Range:** $75,000–$95,000  

**Travel:** 50%\+ \| Typically 3–5 business days per trip, with occasional back\-to\-back travel for up to two consecutive weeks

**Saving Lives with Early Detection**
-------------------------------------


At **HALO Diagnostics (HALO Dx)**, we recognize that every patient is unique—and their healthcare should be too. Our mission is to deliver early detection and precision\-focused healthcare that helps prevent and conquer some of the most impactful diseases.


Through specialized care, advanced diagnostics, and patient\-centered solutions, we are working to make a measurable difference in patient outcomes.

**About the Role**
------------------


The **Deployment \& Training Specialist** is a hands\-on role responsible for helping turn training into successful real\-world execution.


This position is approximately **50% remote training support and 50% on\-site deployment**, supporting both the onboarding of new HALO Navigators and the successful launch of new partner centers across the country.


You’ll help prepare Navigators before launch, travel on\-site to work alongside them during go\-live, reinforce workflows in a live environment, identify and close knowledge gaps, and help ensure each Navigator is confident, competent, and prepared to operate independently following their first week.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys **training people, solving problems, traveling, and being right in the middle of a new\-site launch.**

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Training \& Navigator Development \| \~50%**

* Support the Training team with onboarding and development of new **HALO Navigators**.
* Assist with virtual training sessions, workflow reinforcement, and ongoing skills development.
* Coach Navigators on HALO processes, workflows, patient interactions, and operational expectations.
* Serve as a subject\-matter resource for operational, clinical, and workflow\-related questions.
* Identify knowledge or performance gaps and provide targeted coaching and reinforcement.
* Partner closely with the **Director of Training** to ensure training standards, competencies, and expectations are consistently met.
* Help assess Navigator readiness before and during deployment.

### **Deployment \& New\-Site Launches \| \~50%**

* Travel to partner centers across multiple cities and states to support new\-site launches.
* Participate in launch preparation calls beginning approximately **two weeks before go\-live**.
* Become familiar with each partner center's workflow, staffing model, expectations, and operational nuances before arriving on\-site.
* Work side\-by\-side with the assigned HALO Navigator during the **3–5 day on\-site launch period**.
* Reinforce training in a live environment and provide real\-time coaching and support.
* Identify and close knowledge or workflow gaps that could impact successful independent operation.
* Assess and validate Navigator readiness to independently support the site following the initial launch period.
* Serve as an on\-site HALO representative, helping troubleshoot issues, answer questions, and escalate concerns when necessary.
* Coordinate travel and deployment logistics with the Project Management team.

### **Partner Education \& Lunch \& Learns**

* Plan, coordinate, and facilitate **Lunch \& Learn sessions** for partner center staff.
* Deliver engaging education about HALO programs, workflows, and processes.
* Coordinate catered food orders and other on\-site logistics associated with Lunch \& Learns and training sessions.
* Build positive working relationships with partner center staff and serve as a professional representative of HALO during launches.

### **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Report directly to the **Director of Training**.
* Partner closely with **Project Management** on launch timelines, travel, logistics, and execution.
* Collaborate with Training, Operations, and other HALO teams to resolve issues and ensure successful launches.
* Communicate launch observations, training gaps, and Navigator readiness back to appropriate leadership.
* Help identify opportunities to continuously improve HALO's training and deployment process.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Experience in **training, implementation, deployment, onboarding, or operational support**.
* Demonstrated ability to coach employees and assess readiness in real\-world working environments.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent organization and follow\-through, particularly when managing multiple launch timelines and travel requirements.
* Comfortable working independently and making sound decisions in fast\-moving environments.
* Ability to adapt quickly when workflows, schedules, or launch needs change.
* High degree of professionalism, accountability, and ownership.
* Comfortable traveling **50% or more**, including frequent multi\-day trips.
* Ability to occasionally travel for **two consecutive weeks** when launch schedules require it.

**Preferred Education \& Experience**
-------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in **Business Administration, Education, Project Management**, or a related field preferred, but not required.
* Healthcare, diagnostics, laboratory, or clinical operations experience strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting new\-site launches, implementations, or operational rollouts.
* Prior experience training, coaching, or onboarding operational employees.
* Experience working in a multi\-site or rapidly growing organization is a plus.

**Why Join HALO Dx?**
---------------------


At HALO, your work connects directly to our mission of **Saving Lives with Early Detection**. You'll have the opportunity to help launch programs, develop people, build relationships with our partners, and directly influence the experience patients receive at HALO\-supported locations.


We offer competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package, including:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Life insurance
* 401(k) plan with company match
* Paid vacation, holidays, and sick time
* Stock options in a growing healthcare technology company
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options
* Disability insurance
* Employee discounts


If you're energized by **teaching, traveling, problem\-solving, and helping teams succeed in the real world**, we'd love to hear from you.

**HALO Diagnostics — Saving Lives with Early Detection.**
